f3_program: observe(at("james.main_job.earnings_rate", "current"), 20, "dollar_per_hour", source("James earns $20 an hour while working at his main job"))
percent_less(at("james.second_job.earnings_rate", "current"), at("james.main_job.earnings_rate", "current"), 20, source("He earns 20% less while working his second job"))
observe(at("james.main_job.work_duration", "week"), 30, "hour", source("He works 30 hours at his main job"))
fraction_of(at("james.second_job.work_duration", "week"), at("james.main_job.work_duration", "week"), 1, 2, source("half that much at his second job"))

rate_relation(at("james.main_job.earnings", "week"), at("james.main_job.earnings_rate", "current"), at("james.main_job.work_duration", "week"), source("James earns $20 an hour while working at his main job"))

rate_relation(at("james.second_job.earnings", "week"), at("james.second_job.earnings_rate", "current"), at("james.second_job.work_duration", "week"), source("He earns 20% less while working his second job"))

sum_relation(at("james.earnings.total", "week"), at("james.main_job.earnings", "week"), at("james.second_job.earnings", "week"), source("He works 30 hours at his main job and half that much at his second job.  How much does he earn per week?"))
query("value", at("james.earnings.total", "week"))
